# Step - with_bulk

`with_bulk` · `withBulk` · category: [Modulators and options](../../traversal/step_reference.md#modulators-and-options)

g.with_bulk(false) makes every merge keep bulk 1, so equal traversers collapse at barrier().

## Forms

```text
with_bulk(arg1: bool)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.with_bulk(false).v().out().barrier().count().next()   // 4
```
